summary.text: Becky Lynn Stille is the Democratic nominee for Nebraska's 3rd District. A South Sioux City resident, she works as a quality manager for Ag Processing Inc and is described in local news coverage as a lifelong Nebraskan, mother, and grandmother. She is running on a platform that includes labor-union support, reproductive-healthcare access, secure borders, and Second Amendment rights paired with violence prevention.

paragraphs.text: A South Sioux City resident and farmer, according to a local news report; described there as a lifelong Nebraska resident, mother, and grandmother.
Works as a quality manager for Ag Processing Inc (AGP), according to a local news report.
Her campaign website says she went "from being a single teenage mother to her current position where she earns a six-figure salary," as quoted in a local news report.
Announced her candidacy by August 2025, when a local news report described her as the only Democrat running in 2026 for the seat.
Was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
